d:
Hey, Everyone!~ I have a special surprise for you! The long Moral Succubus drought is over. I have finally finished Latex Rangers to its grand finale. I'm so sorry for the long wait, but I pulled out all of the stops for this one and made it an extra-long one. Nearly 2000 pages. And~ to make this special, this is an uncensored version as recompense for the long wait. Thank you all for your continuing support and I hope that you enjoy the grand finale to Latex Rangers

Anyway, what's the plot synopsis? It has been 1 year (*Cough*) of Queen Malika's invasion of turning everybody into her corrupted soldiers. Thanks to the Latex Ranger's effort, the world has been completely saved, and life has returned to normal. However, Queen Malika still has one trick up her sleeve, and Everly, the leader of the Latex Rangers, has already secretly been corrupted. What will happen to the Latex Rangers? Will Queen Malika win and take over the world? And how will the story end? Well, find out here in the GRAND FINALE OF THE LATEX RANGERS!!!
